library(ggplot2)

mtcars$degC <- as.factor(mtcars$gear)
levels(mtcars$degC) <- c("3°C", "4°C", "5°C")

ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = degC)) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_point()

Cheers,
Roman
